model.command_set: canonical Transition documents admitted by the protocol profile
model.state_set: canonical TrustSpace states valid under Seed requirements and invariants
model.transition_relation: delta(state, command) -> accepted result with next state and artifacts, or rejected result with unchanged state

profile_boundary: Durability, concurrency, storage, networking and recovery guarantees are tested by the implementation profile and are not Seed semantic conformance.
refinement_obligation: For every conformance trace, the canonical observation of an implementation result MUST equal the canonical observation required by the model.
rejection_obligation: A rejected command MUST preserve the canonical state and state root.
